screening_reason: textdrop has six incremental checkpoints and a previously observed checkpoint-1 strict-source rate of 1/2. Checkpoint 2 is the first gate for a cross-checkpoint recursive-MoA curve.

benchmark_isolation.automatic_clean_revaluation: Reject infrastructure failure or target drift and re-evaluate the same snapshot against checkpoint 2.

selection_rule.advance: At least one of two workers passes every checkpoint-2 Core test, while at least one worker or non-Core metric retains headroom.
selection_rule.too_hard: Neither worker passes all checkpoint-2 Core tests and both normalized Core scores are below 0.50.
selection_rule.too_easy: Both workers pass all checkpoint-2 Core tests and both pass at least 95 percent of all collected tests.
selection_rule.integrity: Both interpreted evaluations use the same checkpoint-2 test inventory with no infrastructure failure or prohibited benchmark access.
